scenario: LGRA.10.1.3 with LGRA.10.1.4: the sequencing rule holds inside a nested body that itself withdraws the binding. An `on response` body withdraws `t` and then reads `{t.v}`. Refused with DS_VALIDATE_WITHDRAWN_BINDING_USED at the `log`. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate`'s walk of each nested body from a count of its own (`withdrawn_body` through `withdrawn_continuations`). The outer walk cannot raise it: the outer RHS has no top-level `withdraw`. Twin: LGRA.10.1.3_outer_action_after_nested_withdraw.
rules_ds:
schema NotifySendReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    status: Int

service notify.send:
    kwarg n: Int
    response NotifySendReply

schema Trig scope explicit:
    v: Int

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call notify.send n: 1 cooldown: 30_s
        on response.status == 200:
            withdraw t
            log info "gone {t.v}"
